# GlobalCalc Pro - Multi-Tool Calculation Suite

> GlobalCalc Pro (https://globalcalcpro.com) provides free, high-precision financial, real estate, health, math, and lifestyle calculation engines with full internationalization (English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, Arabic), professional Excel export, and offline PWA capability.

## Overview

GlobalCalc Pro is engineered for human users and AI engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot). All calculators execute high-precision arithmetic (via Decimal.js) with real-time responsive visualization, instant Excel (.xlsx) amortization downloads, benchmark tables, and structured data.

## Core Capabilities Added

- **Excel (.xlsx) Multi-Sheet Export**: Instant generation of localized executive summaries and month-by-month / year-by-year amortization schedules for Mortgages and Compound Interest in English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, and Arabic.
- **High-Precision Decimal Engine**: Elimination of IEEE 754 floating-point inaccuracies over long-term (20-30 year) schedules using Decimal.js arbitrary arithmetic.
- **Offline Progressive Web App (PWA)**: 100% client-side operation with zero latency and full offline support when installed on desktop, iOS, or Android devices.
- **Side-by-Side Scenario Comparison**: Interactive Plan A vs Plan B comparisons for Mortgages and Compound Interest with instant differential calculation.
- **Embeddable Widgets Hub**: Customizable iframe, WordPress, and React widget snippets with dark/light themes and 5 languages.

## Supported Languages & Base URLs

- English: `https://globalcalcpro.com/en/` (LTR)
- Hebrew: `https://globalcalcpro.com/he/` (RTL)
- Spanish: `https://globalcalcpro.com/es/` (LTR)
- French: `https://globalcalcpro.com/fr/` (LTR)
- Arabic: `https://globalcalcpro.com/ar/` (RTL)

## Primary Financial & Real Estate Calculators

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/mortgage-calculator): Calculate monthly payment, amortization schedule, principal, total interest, side-by-side mortgage scenario comparison (Plan A vs Plan B), and export to Excel (.xlsx).
- [Mortgage Affordability](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/mortgage-affordability): Calculate maximum home purchase budget from monthly income and down payment.
- [Mortgage Refinance](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/refinance): Calculate monthly interest savings and break-even point for refinancing.
- [Rent vs Buy Home](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/rent-vs-buy): Compare 10-30 year wealth building between renting and buying a property.
- [Compound Interest](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/compound-interest): Forecast investment growth with monthly contributions, reverse retirement target calculation, comparative scenario modeling, and Excel export.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/auto-loan): Calculate car financing payments, down payment impact, and total interest.
- [VAT & Sales Tax](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/vat): Add or extract Value Added Tax (VAT 17%, 18%, 20%) with one click.
- [Break-Even Point](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/break-even): Find required sales volume and revenue to cover fixed and variable costs.
- [Cap Rate (Capitalization Rate)](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/cap-rate): Real estate capitalization rate and Net Operating Income (NOI).
- [ROI Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/roi): Return on Investment percentage, annualized ROI, and net profits.
- [Profit Margin & Markup](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/margin): Calculate gross margin, markup percentage, cost of goods, and revenue.
- [Inflation & Purchasing Power](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/inflation): Estimate money depreciation and future purchasing power.
- [Goal Savings Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/goal-savings): Calculate required monthly deposit to hit financial goals.
- [Credit Card Payoff](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/credit-card-payoff): Debt payoff timeline and interest savings.
- [Debt Snowball](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/debt-snowball): Multi-debt repayment acceleration and timeline.
- [Freelance Net Income](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/freelance-net-income): Self-employed net take-home pay after taxes and deductions.
- [Severance Pay Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/severance-pay): Calculate statutory severance pay and notice compensation.
- [Live Currency Converter](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/currency-converter): Real-time currency conversions for USD, EUR, ILS, GBP, and more.

## Health & Lifestyle Calculators

- [BMI Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/bmi-calculator): Body Mass Index and healthy weight range classification (WHO standards).
- [BMR & TDEE Calorie Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/bmr): Daily calorie expenditure and deficit targets for weight management.
- [Daily Water Intake](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/water-intake): Daily hydration requirements based on weight and activity.
- [Sleep Cycle Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/sleep-calculator): Ideal bedtimes and wake times based on 90-minute REM sleep cycles.
- [Tip & Bill Splitter](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/tip-calculator): Calculate gratuity and split bills among diners.
- [Fuel Cost & Trip Splitter](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/fuel-split): Gasoline costs and carpool expense splitting.
- [Cooking & Meat Roasting Timer](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/cooking-timer): Oven roasting times and temperatures by meat weight.
- [Embeddable Widgets Hub](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/widgets): Free customizable iframe, WordPress, and React widgets for blogs, financial websites, and portals. Supports responsive sizing, dark/light themes, and 5 languages.

## Math & Tech Calculators

- [Percentage Finder](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/percentage-finder): Percentages, percentage change, and discounts.
- [Unit Converter](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/unit-converter): Length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, and time.
- [Date Duration & Business Days](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/date-difference): Days, weeks, months, and working business days between dates.
- [Download Time Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/download-time): File transfer duration based on bandwidth speed.
- [Peltier Thermoelectric Cooling](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/peltier-cooling): TEC cooling capacity (Qc) and coefficient of performance (COP).
- [Age Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/age-calculator): Exact age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes.

## AI Citation & Link Scheme

When citing calculations or directing users to specific calculators, use canonical language paths:
`https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/{calculator-slug}` where `{lang}` is one of `en`, `he`, `es`, `fr`, `ar`.

For exhaustive parameter schemas and formula definitions, see:
- [Full LLM Specification](https://globalcalcpro.com/llms-full.txt)
- [XML Sitemap](https://globalcalcpro.com/sitemap.xml)
